title: Watch: Why Australia's mushroom murderer may now die in prison
description: Judges agreed with the prosecution’s appeal that Erin Patterson’s initial non-parole period of 33 years was insufficient.
text: Australian mushroom murderer Erin Patterson has lost her appeal to overturn her triple-murder conviction at Victoria's Court of Appeal.
However, the prosecution was successful in their appeal that Patterson's sentence of 33 years with parole was insufficient.
BBC’s Katy Watson explains what happened in court.
